Recipe.Description: Properly browned meat creates foundational flavors. Try this method to avoid gray tasteless meat.

Prerequisites.Prerequisite: Heavy bottomed skillet, ideally black iron.

Method.Step: Heat pan over high heat. Add oil/fat and swirl around pan.

Add meat in one solid piece without breaking it up, like a big burger. Breaking it up will cause the contained liquid to seep into the pan and prevent it from browning. Leave it alone until the bottom is well browned.
When the bottom has sufficiently browned, flip the entire thing and repeat the browning on that side.
Once both sides are browned, you can begin breaking it up, season with salt and pepper and finish browning.
